up: Retrieve approved drugs from ChEMBL with preferred name, canonical SMILES, max clinical phase, mechanism of action, action type, target ChEMBL ID, and target name. Keep only approved drugs with max_phase = 4 that have both a drug_mechanism row and a compound_structures row with canonical_smiles. Return DISTINCT rows only for exactly chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, and target_name. Keep drugs even when target_chembl_id and target_name are missing; those target columns may be null.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.max_phase,
  dm.mechanism_of_action,
  dm.action_type,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name
FROM molecule_dictionary md
INNER JOIN drug_mechanism dm ON dm.molregno = md.molregno
INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN target_dictionary td ON td.tid = dm.tid
WHERE
  md.max_phase = 4
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL;
